zh.title: 荷蘭皇家航空首架A350-900完成首飛 預計10月投入商業營運
zh.summary: 荷蘭皇家航空首架A350完成首飛；預計10月23日投入阿姆斯特丹至多倫多航線。
body: 荷蘭皇家航空（KLM）預計接收的首架空中巴士 A350-900 客機，於 2026 年 9 月 4 日順利完成首次試飛。該架新機目前使用臨時國籍標誌暨登記號碼 F-WZNM，於法國圖盧茲-布拉尼亞克機場（TLS）起飛，在法國南部上空進行了長達 1 小時 34 分鐘的測試飛行後，順利降落於同一機場，完成交付前例行的新機測試流程。

這架空中巴士 A350-900 被命名為「夜巡」（The Night Watch），名稱取自荷蘭畫家林布蘭（Rembrandt）的著名藝術傑作。這是荷蘭皇家航空預計接收的 22 架 A350 客機中的第一架，源自法航-荷航集團（Air France-KLM Group）於 2023 年所訂購的 50 架客機訂單（另含 40 架選擇權）。荷航數十年來主要營運波音機隊，此機交付標誌著其機隊轉型的重要里程碑，該公司自 2024 年 1 月接收首架空中巴士 A320neo 後，便逐步引進空中巴士機型。
根據營運規劃，「夜巡」號預計於 2026 年 10 月 23 日正式投入商業營運。此日期較荷蘭皇家航空原本規劃的 10 月 9 日推遲了數日。該機首航將執飛阿姆斯特丹史基浦機場（AMS）至多倫多皮爾遜國際機場（YYZ）的客運航線，航班號碼為 KL691 與 KL692，目前該跨大西洋航線係由波音 787 機型負責執飛。
在客艙配置方面，荷蘭皇家航空的 A350 客機規劃設置 332 個座位，其中包括 34 個商務艙座位、26 個豪華經濟艙座位以及 271 個經濟艙座位。然而，由於商務艙座椅認證過程出現延誤，荷蘭皇家航空在該型客機投入營運初期，可能面臨必須在商務艙不載客的情況下執行航班的挑戰。

en.title: KLM's First Airbus A350-900 Completes Maiden Flight Ahead of October Launch
en.summary: KLM's first Airbus A350-900 completed its maiden flight; commercial service starts October 23 to Toronto.
body: The first Airbus A350-900 aircraft scheduled for delivery to Dutch flag carrier KLM completed its maiden flight on September 4, 2026. Bearing the provisional registration F-WZNM, the widebody jet departed from France's Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) and returned to land at the same airport 1 hour and 34 minutes later, after executing a routine test flight circuit over southern France prior to its official customer delivery.

Named 'The Night Watch' after Rembrandt's iconic masterpiece, the widebody airliner is the first of 22 A350 aircraft that KLM is set to receive. The aircraft are part of a broader order for 50 aircraft, accompanied by 40 options, placed by the Air France-KLM Group in 2023. This delivery marks a significant milestone in KLM's fleet renewal, as the Dutch carrier undergoes a major transition toward Airbus after operating primarily Boeing aircraft for many decades. The airline's shift to Airbus began in January 2024 when it took delivery of its first A320neo.

'The Night Watch' is scheduled to enter commercial passenger service on October 23, 2026, representing a brief postponement from KLM's original target date of October 9, 2026. The new aircraft will make its commercial debut on the route connecting Amsterdam-Schiphol (AMS) Airport and Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ). Operating under flight numbers KL691 and KL692, this transatlantic service is currently performed using Boeing 787 aircraft.

KLM's A350 configuration is designed to accommodate a total of 332 passengers, featuring 34 seats in business class, 26 in premium economy, and 271 in economy class. However, regulatory delays in seat certification mean that the Dutch airline may be required to operate its initial A350 commercial flights with an empty business class cabin until official certification approval is finalized.

zh.title: Britten-Norman完成英製Islander首飛
zh.summary: Britten-Norman宣布Islander首款英國製機完成首飛
body: 飛機製造商Britten-Norman宣布，自2023年全面生產重返英國後，首架於英國製造的Islander飛機已完成首次試飛。
2026年9月3日，Britten-Norman確認，從懷特島新生產線下線的首架Islander已成功起飛。公司聲明指出：「這是我們新生產線下線的第一架飛機，機身是在懷特島上從零件開始組裝。」
八天前，公司才宣布在滾出廠房後開始地面測試；該機自7月30日出廠。
目前正在測試的飛機未來將加入福克蘭群島政府航空服務（FIGS）機隊。

en.title: Britten-Norman completes maiden flight of first UK-built Islander
en.summary: Britten-Norman completes first flight of UK-built Islander from Isle of Wight line; aircraft destined for FIGS.
body: Planemaker Britten-Norman has celebrated the maiden test flight of the first Islander aircraft built in the UK since full production returned to British shores in 2023.
On September 3, 2026, Britten-Norman confirmed that the first Islander to come off the new production line on the Isle of Wight had taken to the skies.
The company said the airframe was built from detail components on the Isle of Wight, with the aircraft rolling out over a month later, on August 27.
The Islander currently being tested is destined to join the Falkland Islands Government Air Service (FIGS) fleet.
In June 2026, Britten-Norman announced that a second airframe was nearly 25% complete and that components for follow-on aircraft were in manufacture.
